turns.user: Which published cement pastes have a plastic viscosity of 20 Pa.s or less together with a mini-slump flow diameter of at least 180 mm?
turns.text:
I’ll check the database for cement pastes with both reported measurements meeting your limits, then retrieve the publication details.
The search found matching paste records, including OPC and calcium sulfoaluminate mixes. It also returned alkali-activated and lime pastes, which I’ll distinguish from cement pastes. The publication-count query timed out; I’ll retry with a simpler join.
**Yes—published cement pastes meeting both limits include the following.** These are literature measurements recorded for the same mix, not model predictions.

| Published mix | Composition summary | w/b | Plastic viscosity (Pa·s) | Mini-slump diameter (mm) | Publication |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| No.1 | OPC control; PCE | 0.30 | 1.16 | 260 | [CSA cement paste rheology](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118234) |
| No.10 | CSA cement + silica fume; PCE | 0.24 | 2.97 | 245 | [Same paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118234) |
| REF, w/b=0.35 | OPC + limestone powder; PCE | 0.35 | 0.57 | 330 | [Nanoclays and SCC paste rheology](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2020.118285) |
| PCPA00 | OPC; PCE | 0.29 | 1.19 | 250 | [PCE–APAM cement paste study](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cscm.2024.e03895) |
| OPC0.3 | OPC control; PCE | 0.30 | 1.16 | 260 | [CSA paste pore-characteristics study](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.powtec.2021.04.027) |
| M1 | OPC + Class F fly ash; PCE | 0.30 | 1.14 | 268 | [Cement-based materials optimization](https://doi.org/10.3389/fmats.2021.712551) |

For No.1 and No.10, both values come directly from **Table 2**; viscosity is the Bingham-model value.

The broader database search returned **100 paste mix records across 12 papers**, including alkali-activated, earth and hydraulic-lime pastes. The table above is a cement-paste shortlist. Measurements were matched by mix identity; test timing and protocols should be checked before comparing or reproducing them.
